rows.Origin:
Bred by Simon (Simó) Dot (Spain, 1973).
Introduced in France by Florida S.A.R.L. in 1976 as 'Joaquina Muñoz'.
rows.Bloom: Cherry-red, red reverse. Mild fragrance. up to 23 petals. Large, double (17-25 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit: Compact, upright. Glossy, dark green foliage.
